info.title: StreamHub core API
info.description: Management layer over LiveKit (AntMedia-style). REST API under /api/v1. Every response is a {data,error} envelope. SPEC §6.

rtmpPassword.description: Require a password besides the RTMP key.

splitMinutes.description: Split the recording into N-minute MP4 parts (each part = its own VOD). 0 = continuous single file.

snapshotSeconds.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot every N seconds during the recording. 0 = off.

callbackSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign callbacks.

yaml.example:
name: live
room_prefix: live
recording:
  enabled: true

public_url.description: Public/CDN base URL for objects. When set, VOD URLs are <public_url>/<key>.

key.description: S3 access key — stored in secrets.json, never the yaml.

secret.description: S3 secret key — stored in secrets.json, never the yaml.

confirmPublic.description: Fold-3: required (true) to ENABLE a non-empty public_url — this makes recordings publicly accessible (not presigned). Not needed to clear it.

cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between latency_high alerts per room.

url.description: Broker URL: mqtt:// | mqtts:// | ws:// | wss:// (path allowed, e.g. wss://mqtt.example.com/mqtt).

password.description: Broker password — stored in secrets.json, never the yaml.

events.description: Event filter: ['all'] or explicit event names.

cidr.description: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR (a.b.c.d/nn, 2001:db8::/32) or a bare IP (implied /32 or /128).

token.description: Plaintext token, returned only once. Store it now.

teamName.description: Optional team/tenant display name. Defaults to the email.

token.description: HS256 JWT (sub=user, ~12h expiry). Send as Bearer token.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code — required when the account has 2FA enabled (the API answers 401 `totp_required` without it).

message.description: Generic acknowledgement. Intentionally reveals nothing about whether the email exists or a link was actually sent (anti-enumeration).
message.example: If that email is valid, we just sent a sign-in link.

token.description: The one-time token from the emailed magic link.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code — required when the account has 2FA enabled (the API answers 401 `totp_required` without it; the link is NOT burnt).

role.description: Membership role in the team. Defaults to 'viewer'.

name.description: Stable node name (also the upsert key). [a-zA-Z0-9._-], 1-64.

ip.description: The node public IP (IPv4 or IPv6).

url.description: Public URL of the node; falls back to `ip` when omitted.

nodeId.description: The node id handed back by /cluster/join.

stats.description: Free-form node stats (e.g. cpu, mem, activeStreams). Persisted verbatim in the registry (last-write-wins) and capped at ~4KB serialized (413/400 over the limit). Omit to send a bare liveness ping.

status.description: Administrative state: 'active' (serving), 'draining' (finish in-flight, take no new work) or 'disabled' (parked).

masterUrl.description: API base URL of the cluster master.

nodeName.description: Stable name for this node in the master registry. [a-zA-Z0-9._-], 1-64.

nodeIp.description: This node public IP reported to the master. Auto-detected when omitted.

nodeUrl.description: Public URL of this node (falls back to nodeIp at the master).

masterToken.description: The master's global Bearer token (sk_…) for the best-effort de-register.

plan.description: Plan label stored on the tenant row. 1-64 chars.

maxApps.description: Max apps the tenant may own. -1 = unlimited.

maxConcurrentStreams.description: Max concurrent live streams across the tenant. -1 = unlimited.

maxEgressGbMonth.description: Monthly egress budget in GB. -1 = unlimited.

maxStorageGb.description: Total storage budget in GB. -1 = unlimited.

content.description: Full HTML contents of the sample file.

room.description: Room name within the app. Namespaced with the app room prefix if not already prefixed. Defaults to the app prefix.

identity.description: Participant identity. Defaults to a random identity.

ttl.description: Token TTL (zeit/ms span or seconds). Defaults to "6h".

hidden.description: Hidden participant (QC/recorder): subscribes to all media but is invisible and not counted as a viewer. SPEC §16.

recorder.description: Mark token as a recorder/QC grant (roomRecord). Pairs with hidden. SPEC §16.

audioOnly.description: Audio-only: restrict publishing to the microphone source (no camera/screenshare). Wave-4 §5/§6.

inputType.description: rtmp = push URL+key; whip = WHIP endpoint; url = pull source.

room.description: Destination room. Namespaced with the app prefix if not already prefixed. Defaults to the app prefix.

participantIdentity.description: Participant identity for the ingress. Defaults to a generated id.

url.description: Required when inputType = url. The remote source to pull.

enableTranscoding.description: Enable server-side transcoding (multi-layer). Required for rtmp/url; optional for whip. Defaults from app rtmp.transcode.

backup.description: RTMP only: also mint a BACKUP (failover) stream key bound to the SAME room. Both keys publish into one room, so the player/playback URL is unchanged whichever key is live. Point a redundant/failover encoder at the backup key and keep it on standby; if the primary drops, the backup keeps the channel alive with no URL change. Ignored for whip/url.

topic.description: Data topic. `chat`/`reaction` map to the chat_message/reaction callbacks.

message.description: Convenience text message (chat). Mutually fine with `payload`.

payload.description: Raw payload to broadcast. When omitted, an envelope is built from message/reaction.

destinationIdentities.description: Restrict delivery to these participant identities.

metadata.description: Opaque metadata string attached to the live room (typically JSON). Connected clients receive `roomMetadataChanged`.

trackSid.description: Track sid to mute. When omitted, `kind` selects the tracks to mute.

kind.description: Which published tracks to mute when no trackSid is given. Default 'all'.

metadata.description: Opaque participant metadata (typically JSON). Clients receive `participantMetadataChanged`.

trackSids.description: Track sids to (un)subscribe the participant to.

detail.example: no NVIDIA (nvidia-smi) and no VAAPI (/dev/dri render node)

snapshot.description: Snapshot filename as listed by GET /system/backups, e.g. '2026-07-06T03-30-00-000Z.db.gz'.

confirm.description: Must be literally true to authorize overwriting the live database.

participantIdentity.description: Publisher identity for track/audio modes. Defaults to the stream participant/id.

streamId.description: Logical stream id. In participant/track/audio modes it is also used as the participant identity to egress.

recordMode.description: composite (default, per app config — headless-Chrome room render) | track (one publisher audio+video, ffmpeg TrackComposite, no Chrome) | audio (audio-only TrackComposite).

participantIdentity.description: Publisher identity for track/audio modes. Defaults to streamId.

viewers.description: Live subscriber count (SPEC §16): excludes publishers and hidden/QC. Present on detail reads when features.viewerCounter is on.

disabled.description: Plugin ids this stream is opted OUT of (disabled).

participantIdentity.description: Optional participant identity to snapshot; defaults to the room composite.

egressId.description: LiveKit egress id of the HLS egress.

playlistUrl.description: Public URL of the live HLS playlist (.m3u8).

egressId.description: Egress id that was stopped, or null if none was active.

active.description: Whether a live HLS playlist is available.

playlistUrl.description: Public URL of the live HLS playlist (.m3u8).

config.description: Partial config; keys/values validated against the plugin configSchema.

env.description: Environment variables (string→string). Includes the origin-facing STREAMHUB_INGEST_URL/TOKEN when the plugin feeds results back.

ingestToken.description: Per-start ingest token (GRID-3) the worker echoes to the origin; also mirrored into STREAMHUB_INGEST_TOKEN if not already present in env.

scope.description: 'vods' = VODs (+S3+local cascade); 'logs' = the app's server_logs; 'all' = all app-scoped data but keep the app + its config.

confirm.description: Must be literally true to authorize the destructive purge.

roomName.description: LiveKit room to broadcast (namespaced under the app prefix).

platform.description: Destination platform. Presets (youtube/twitch/facebook) build the push URL from their well-known ingest base + `key`; `custom` uses `url` as-is.

url.description: Full RTMP/RTMPS destination URL (required for platform "custom").

key.description: Destination stream key (required for preset platforms). Stored server-side only; API responses always mask it.

startAt.description: Absolute reveal instant as unix epoch MILLISECONDS (UTC). Computed browser-side from the picked wall-time + timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-time was picked in (display/round-trip).

room.description: Room this premiere applies to. Omit / null → every room in the app.

title.description: Friendly title shown in the agenda and on the cover.

message.description: Optional message shown under the countdown headline.

enabled.description: Whether the event is active (drives the countdown).

startAt.description: New absolute reveal instant (unix epoch MILLISECONDS, UTC).

timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-time was picked in.

room.description: Room this premiere applies to (null → every room).

layers.description: Rendition ladder (e.g. 720/480/240). Replaces the full ladder. An empty array clears it (no explicit ladder — delivery uses derived/LiveKit defaults); omit the field to leave it unchanged.

rtmpTranscode.description: Transcode RTMP ingress to a multi-layer ladder.

hwaccel.description: GPU hardware-transcoding preference (SPEC §5). 'auto' (default) uses the GPU when the node has one, else CPU; 'gpu' forces GPU (falls back to CPU if none); 'cpu' always uses software.

transcodingEnabled.description: Master switch for server-side transcoding (config.yaml `transcoding.enabled`). Default false on new apps: pure passthrough — RTMP ingress is not re-encoded and recordings stay single-file H.264. Must be true for rtmpTranscode / encoding / vodAdaptive to take effect.

encoding.description: Recording output encoding target: 'h264' (MP4 only, egress-native) or 'h264+vp8' (also generate a WebM/VP8 alternate via ffmpeg post-transcode).

vodAdaptive.description: Generate an adaptive HLS VOD per recording: a master playlist + one rendition per ladder step (ffmpeg post-transcode, stored as VOD variants).

vodRenditions.description: Explicit VOD rendition ladder (replaces the whole list). Empty/omitted = derive from webrtc.layers heights with default per-height bitrates.

room.description: Room the camera publishes into (namespaced under the app prefix).

identity.description: Participant identity of the camera (default: wscam-<key suffix>).
